# CVS
> Online pharmacy, prescriptions, health services, photo printing, rewards, and wellness resources from CVS.

CVS combines digital pharmacy tools, retail shopping, walk-in and virtual care, photo services, and loyalty programs. The site supports prescription refills and transfers, clinic visits, store and pharmacy lookup, health content, and account-based services through web and mobile experiences.

## Pharmacy
- [CVS Pharmacy](https://www.cvs.com/pharmacy): Main pharmacy hub for prescriptions, refills, transfers, delivery, and pharmacy services.
- [Refill and Manage Prescriptions](https://www.cvs.com/pharmacy/rxrefill): Refill eligible prescriptions online and manage medications from your CVS account.
- [Transfer Prescriptions](https://www.cvs.com/pharmacy/transfer): Move prescriptions to CVS from another pharmacy online.
- [Pharmacy Services](https://www.cvs.com/pharmacy/services): Overview of pharmacy offerings including vaccinations, adherence, and medication support.
- [Find a CVS Pharmacy](https://www.cvs.com/store-locator/landing): Search for nearby CVS Pharmacy locations, hours, and store services.
- [Pharmacy Delivery](https://www.cvs.com/content/delivery): Information about prescription delivery and same-day delivery availability.

## MinuteClinic and Care
- [MinuteClinic](https://www.cvs.com/minuteclinic): Walk-in and virtual care for common illnesses, screenings, and wellness services.
- [MinuteClinic Services](https://www.cvs.com/minuteclinic/services): Browse care categories and treatment services available through MinuteClinic.
- [Virtual Care](https://www.cvs.com/minuteclinic/virtual-care): Access telehealth visits for select conditions through MinuteClinic virtual care.
- [Find a MinuteClinic](https://www.cvs.com/minuteclinic/clinic-locator): Locate nearby MinuteClinic sites and view clinic availability.
- [Oak Street Health](https://www.cvs.com/content/oak-street-health): Learn about primary care services for older adults through Oak Street Health.

## Vaccines and Immunizations
- [Vaccinations at CVS Pharmacy](https://www.cvs.com/immunizations/get-vaccinated): Schedule and learn about vaccines offered at CVS Pharmacy.
- [COVID-19 Vaccine](https://www.cvs.com/immunizations/covid-19-vaccine): COVID-19 vaccine scheduling and eligibility information.
- [Flu Shots](https://www.cvs.com/immunizations/flu): Flu shot information, scheduling, and seasonal vaccine details.
- [Immunization Services](https://www.cvs.com/pharmacy/immunizations): Pharmacy immunization overview and supported vaccine services.

## Shopping and Store Services
- [Shop CVS](https://www.cvs.com/shop): Online shopping for health, beauty, household, and everyday essentials.
- [Weekly Ad](https://www.cvs.com/shop/weeklyad): Browse current CVS weekly deals, promotions, and featured products.
- [Same-Day Delivery](https://www.cvs.com/content/same-day-delivery): Details on same-day delivery for eligible CVS products and orders.
- [Store Locator](https://www.cvs.com/store-locator/cvs-pharmacy-locations): Find CVS store locations by city, state, or ZIP code.
- [Order Status](https://www.cvs.com/orderstatus): Check the status of CVS online retail orders.

## ExtraCare and Savings
- [ExtraCare](https://www.cvs.com/extracare/home): Loyalty program hub for rewards, deals, and member savings.
- [ExtraCare Pharmacy & Health Rewards](https://www.cvs.com/extracare/pharmacyrewards): Earn rewards through eligible pharmacy and health-related activities.
- [CVS Coupons](https://www.cvs.com/shop/content/coupons): Access digital coupons and savings offers for online and in-store shopping.
- [Deals and Promotions](https://www.cvs.com/shop/deals): Browse featured discounts and promotional offers across CVS categories.

## Photo
- [CVS Photo](https://www.cvs.com/photo): Main photo printing hub for prints, cards, gifts, and custom products.
- [Prints and Enlargements](https://www.cvs.com/photo/prints): Order photo prints and enlargements for pickup or delivery.
- [Photo Books](https://www.cvs.com/photo/photo-books): Create custom photo books with CVS Photo.
- [Cards](https://www.cvs.com/photo/cards): Design personalized cards for holidays, birthdays, and special occasions.
- [Canvas Prints](https://www.cvs.com/photo/canvas-prints): Turn photos into canvas wall art and personalized décor.
- [Same-Day Photo](https://www.cvs.com/photo/same-day-photo): Explore same-day photo products available for quick pickup.

## Health Information and Wellness
- [CVS HealthHub](https://www.cvs.com/content/health-hub): Information about expanded health services and in-store care support.
- [Wellness and Health Articles](https://www.cvs.com/learn): Health, wellness, nutrition, and condition-related educational content.
- [Cold and Flu Center](https://www.cvs.com/shop/content/cold-and-flu): Shop products and read guidance for cold and flu season.
- [Allergy Center](https://www.cvs.com/shop/content/allergy): Allergy relief products and seasonal allergy information.

## Mobile and Digital Tools
- [CVS Mobile Apps](https://www.cvs.com/mobile-cvs/apps): Download CVS apps for pharmacy, shopping, rewards, and photo management.
- [CVS Pharmacy App](https://www.cvs.com/mobile-cvs/apps#pharmacy-app): Mobile pharmacy tools for refills, prescription tracking, and account access.
- [CVS Photo App](https://www.cvs.com/mobile-cvs/apps#photo-app): Mobile photo ordering and print management from your device.

## Account and Customer Support
- [Sign In](https://www.cvs.com/account/login): Access your CVS account for prescriptions, orders, rewards, and preferences.
- [Create an Account](https://www.cvs.com/account/create): Register for a CVS account to manage pharmacy, shopping, and rewards services.
- [Help Center](https://www.cvs.com/help/help_index.jsp): Customer support resources for orders, pharmacy, account, and site assistance.
- [Contact Us](https://www.cvs.com/help/email-customer-relations.jsp): Contact CVS customer relations for support and service questions.
